title: Sixth College General Education
source_note: Sixth 学院官网 GE 要求页 + UCSD catalog（2026-10-28 核对）；低年级广度课单按学期公布，只写规则 + 链接。

sections.title: Culture, Art, and Technology
sections.title_zh: 文化、艺术与技术核心序列

requirements.name: Culture, Art, and Technology
requirements.note: CAT 1 (4 units, fall), CAT 2 (6 units, winter), CAT 3 (6 units, spring). CAT 2/3 include intensive instruction in university-level writing.
requirements.note_zh: CAT 1（4 学分，秋）+ CAT 2（6 学分，冬）+ CAT 3（6 学分，春）；CAT 2/3 含大学写作强化训练。

sections.title: Lower-Division Breadth

requirements.name: Information Technology Fluency
requirements.note: 1 computing or programming course from the college-approved breadth list (published each quarter).
requirements.note_zh: 信息技术 fluency 1 门（编程/计算方向），按学院每学期公布的广度清单选。

requirements.name: Social Analysis
requirements.note: 2 social science courses from the college-approved breadth list.
requirements.note_zh: 社会分析 2 门（社会科学），按学院广度清单选。

requirements.name: Narrative, Aesthetic, and Historical Reasoning
requirements.note: 2 humanities courses from the college-approved breadth list.
requirements.note_zh: 叙事、审美与历史推理 2 门（人文），按学院广度清单选。

requirements.name: Analytical and Scientific Methods
requirements.note: 2 science courses from the college-approved breadth list (options for science and nonscience majors).
requirements.note_zh: 分析与科学方法 2 门（科学），按学院广度清单选（分理工/非理工方向）。

requirements.name: Structured Reasoning
requirements.note: 1 math or logic course from the college-approved breadth list.
requirements.note_zh: 结构化推理 1 门（数学或逻辑），按学院广度清单选。

requirements.name: Exploring Data
requirements.note: 1 statistics course from the college-approved breadth list.
requirements.note_zh: 探索数据 1 门（统计），按学院广度清单选。

requirements.name: Art Making
requirements.note: Art Making, 8 units (2 courses) in literature, music, theatre and dance, or visual arts, from the college-approved breadth list.
requirements.note_zh: 艺术创作 8 学分（2 门：文学/音乐/戏剧舞蹈/视觉艺术），按学院广度清单选。

sections.note: 11 lower-division breadth courses from quarterly lists.
sections.note_zh: 低年级广度 11 门，按学期清单选。

sections.title: Upper-Division Requirements

requirements.name: Experiential Learning
requirements.note: 1 four-unit upper-division experiential learning course (CAT 90 or CAT 124, or an approved department course, Academic Internship Program, or Study Abroad Program course). May overlap major, minor, and university requirements.
requirements.note_zh: 体验学习 1 门（4 学分高年级：CAT 90 或 CAT 124，或学院批准的系课、学术实习、留学项目课）；可与专业/辅修/校级要求重叠。

requirements.name: Upper-Division Writing
requirements.note: CAT 125 or CAT 125R (Public Rhetoric and Practical Communication), 4 units.
requirements.note_zh: CAT 125 或 CAT 125R（公共修辞与实用沟通），4 学分。

sections.note_zh: 体验学习 1 门 + CAT 125 高年级写作 1 门。
